svg.aria-label: React Native and Expo GitLab CI/CD architecture: developers push to GitLab; a shell runner builds Android APK and AAB locally inside a Docker builder image with an SSD cache; iOS builds run in Expo EAS cloud and go to TestFlight; the production AAB is submitted to Google Play and Huawei AppGallery; the bottom strip shows the ten pipeline steps.
svg.text: One GitLab pipeline → Google Play, Huawei AppGallery and the App Store · DevOps portfolio
test → image → apk → cloud → TestFlight → aab → stores
rebuilt only when Dockerfile or package*.json change
node_modules reused when the package-lock md5 matches
GRADLE_OPTS -Xmx6g · parallel · build cache · daemon off
prune Docker builder cache · clear stale Gradle locks · free page cache
eas submit · API key written at runtime, then deleted
eas submit · production track · draft release
eas update → development · preview · production channels

g.text: ▶ APK for testers · ▶ iOS build → TestFlight
